note: A 26-year-old salaried municipal firefighter is not a business owner, a physician or an equivalent — the ICP as stated screens for people who are already established, and he says himself "I still haven't done the things yet... I haven't even done any major things yet in my life." He clears the affordability test comfortably (paid $6,000 with no objection, no plan requested) and he is a long-standing athlete rather than a deconditioned gym-averse beginner, so the exclusion criterion is not close. The good-to-great test is where he genuinely fails: he describes a year of near-total collapse in discipline, near-syncope on the job, dependence on stimulants to function and a self-described slump — that is closer to rescue than to optimisation. He fits the buying population, not the stated profile, which is the same pattern already logged against the Robyn Stillwater close.
